Frequently asked questions

Is Enge safe?

Wandroz currently rates Enge in Zurich, Switzerland as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Zurich, Switzerland during the day and relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Zurich, Switzerland at night. This is a qualitative first-pass assessment based on general local knowledge and public reputation, not an official geolocated crime dataset or press research — see the note on data limitations below before treating it as more precise than it is.

Is Enge safe at night?

At night, Enge is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Zurich, Switzerland. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Enge a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Enge's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Zurich, Switzerland) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
